name: ИИ на заказ — дизайн-система (снята с npopko55-cmd.github.io/ii-na-zakaz, коммит 453d85f)

fontFamilies.display: 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', 'Oswald', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif — 800/900, UPPERCASE, line-height .88–.94, letter-spacing -.005em, worn noise mask
fontFamilies.logo: 'Rubik Wet Paint' (ИИ) + 'Rubik Spray Paint' (НА ЗАКАЗ), rotate(-3deg)

sizes.fluid_rule: clamp(min, a + b·vw, max), линейно от 390 px до 1440 px

rules: каждый блок — сцена: градиент фона от цвета предыдущего блока (--pc), фактуры, пятна света
текст слева, картинка справа; на телефоне одна колонка
кнопка первого экрана видна без прокрутки на 390×844, 375×667, 320×568
на телефоне ряды карточек — горизонтальная лента со щелчком

buttons.primary: height 76→60, radius 12, gradient + pink glow, dark icon square #141016 52→42 radius 9 with white line icon, label Inter 800 UPPERCASE; hover brightness 1.08; active translateY(1px)
buttons.secondary: height 56, radius 12, border rgba(255,255,255,.28), bg rgba(255,255,255,.04), Inter 700 UPPERCASE

components.glass: linear-gradient(160deg, white 16% → 5% → 3%) over rgba(22,16,28,.42), border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.26), backdrop blur 14 saturate 1.2, inset top highlight, shadow 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.42), radius 14–18
components.fact_chip: rgba(18,15,22,.6), border 20% white, blur 12, radius 12, check-circle icon 28
components.hint_pill: pink bg, white Inter 700, radius 12 12 12 3, rotate(-1.5deg)
components.slot_card: radius 18, gradient rgba(36,24,40,.78)→rgba(18,12,20,.9), pink radial glow, border 14%, inner dashed border 7%
components.accordion: lines 14%, number Sofia 48 (40% → white), title Inter 700, chevron circle 28 rotates 180°, one open
components.dock: fixed glass capsule radius 20 (desktop), full-width glass strip (phone), appears after first screen

textures: pink floor light under hero objects

motion.rule: once on reveal, transform/opacity only, static with prefers-reduced-motion

imagery.people: semi-realistic digital painting, comic shading, pink rim light, cut out (transparent)
imagery.objects: glossy 3D, dark graphite/black chrome + hot pink accents, 3/4 top view, transparent
imagery.backgrounds: night loft / night city, pink neon, purple-black shadows; desktop 2000–2400px + phone 900×1613 WebP
